title: Requesting Information About a Mobile Plan

content.scenario: A consumer, Priya, wants to know the details of her mobile phone plan, including data limits, call rates, and any additional charges. She contacts her mobile service provider to request this information.
content.outcome: The mobile service provider provides Priya with a detailed breakdown of her plan, including all the information she requested, enabling her to make informed decisions about her usage.
